[[Club Africain|CA]] 5–1 [[ES Métlaoui|ESM]] | longest wins = 7 games ([[Club Africain|CA]]) | longest unbeaten = 18 games ([[Espérance Sportive de Tunis|EST]]) | longest winless = 14 games ([[Espérance Sportive de Zarzis|ESZ]]) | longest losses = 10 games ([[Union Sportive de Ben Guerdane|USBG]]) | matches = 182 | total goals = 387 | prevseason = [[2016–17 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2016–17]] | nextseason = [[2018–19 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2018–19]] }} The '''2017–18 [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1]]''' (''Tunisian Professional League'') season was the 63rd season of top-tier football in [[Tunisia]]. The season calendar was drawn on July 24.{{Cite web|url=http://www.kawarji.com/actu-39459-ligue_1_la_lnfp_communique_la_date_du_tirage_au_sort_du_calendrier.html|title=Ligue 1 : La LNFP communique la date du tirage au sort du calendrier}} The competition started on August 15.{{Cite web|url=http://www.kawarji.com/actu-39815-ligue_1_programme_de_la_premiere_journee.html|title = Ligue 1 : Programme de la première journée}} ==Teams== A total of 14 teams contested the league, including 11 sides from the [[2016–17 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2016–17 season]] and three promoted from the [[2016–17 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2016–17 Ligue 2]]. [[Union Sportive Monastirienne (football)|Union Monastirienne]] and [[Stade Tunisien]] obtained promotion after winning their penultimate game of the season, while [[Club Olympique de Médenine|Olympique Médenine]] won the promotion playoff against [[Avenir Sportif de La Marsa|Avenir de Marsa]]. The three teams replaced the five teams that were relegated to [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2017–18 Tunisian Ligue 2]] in order to reduce the number of teams from 16 to 14. ===Stadiums and locations=== {{Location map+ |Tunisia |width=325 |float=above |caption=Locations of the 2017–18 Ligue 1 teams |places= {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=33.883333 |long=10.116667 |label=[[Avenir Sportif de Gabès|ASG]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=36.8 |long=10.183333 |label=[[Club Africain|CA]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=37.266667 |long=9.866667 |label=[[CA Bizertin|CAB]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=33.354722 |long=10.505278 |label=[[Club Olympique de Médenine|COM]] |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=34.733333 |long=10.766667 |label=[[Club Sportif Sfaxien|CSS]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=34.333333 |long=8.4 |label=[[ES Métlaoui|ESM]] |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=35.833333 |long=10.633333 |label=[[Étoile Sportive du Sahel|ESS]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=36.8 |long=10.183333 |label=[[Espérance Sportive de Tunis|EST]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=33.5 |long=11.116667 |label=[[Espérance Sportive de Zarzis|ESZ]] |position=top}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=35.666667 |long=10.1 |label=[[Jeunesse Sportive Kairouanaise|JSK]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=33.883333 |long=10.116667 |label=[[Stade Gabèsien|SG]] |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=36.8 |long=10.183333 |label=[[Stade Tunisien|ST]] |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=33.138889 |long=11.216667 |label=[[Union Sportive de Ben Guerdane|USBG]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=35.783333 |long=10.833333 |label=[[Union Sportive Monastirienne (football)|USM]] |position=right}} }} {|class="wikitable sortable" ! width="120px" | Team ! width="120px" | Location ! width="150px" | Stadium !
